guideline: ol/control/Attribution: collapsible (if unset each source decides), collapsed defaults to true at startup, collapseLabel defaults to '›'. A collapsed-at-start attribution conflicts with the OSMF visibility-without-interaction rule.
keywords: attribution collapse; collapsed; collapsible; collapseLabel; OSMF; attribution visible
do: Set collapsed:false so attribution is visible at startup, or only use OSMF-accepted collapse patterns.
dont: Ship the default collapsed attribution on OSM-based maps.

guideline: Vector sources have attributionsCollapsible default true.
do: Set attributionsCollapsible:false on sources whose credit must stay visible.
dont: Assume source attribution is always shown expanded.

guideline: ol/control/defaults options: attribution (true), rotate (true), zoom, plus attributionOptions and rotateOptions.
keywords: control defaults; defaults; attributionOptions; rotateOptions; zoom control
do: Configure default controls through ol/control/defaults and its attributionOptions.
dont: Remove default controls without replacing them.

guideline: The Rotate control has autoHide default true and hides itself when rotation is 0.
keywords: rotate control; autoHide; north reset; rotation
do: Keep autoHide so the rotate button appears only when the map is rotated.
dont: Leave a permanent rotate button on a north-up map.

guideline: ol/interaction/defaults has keyboard default true and zoomDelta (zoom delta when using keyboard or double click).
keywords: interaction defaults; keyboard; zoomDelta; keyboard accessibility
do: Keep keyboard interactions enabled and tune zoomDelta if needed.
dont: Disable keyboard interactions on interactive maps.

guideline: KeyboardPan uses arrow keys with pixelDelta default 128 px; events attach to the map div unless keyboardEventTarget is set.
keywords: KeyboardPan; arrow keys; pixelDelta; keyboardEventTarget; keyboard pan
do: Set keyboardEventTarget deliberately if the map is not the focus target.
dont: Assume keyboard events work without focus on the map div.

guideline: KeyboardZoom uses the +/- keys with delta default 1.
keywords: KeyboardZoom; plus minus keys; zoom delta; keyboard zoom
do: Keep KeyboardZoom so +/- keys zoom the map.
dont: Remove KeyboardZoom while offering only mouse zoom.

guideline: VectorTileLayer renderMode defaults to 'hybrid' (polygons and lines as images, points and text as vectors above them). 'vector' keeps the render order.
keywords: VectorTile; renderMode; hybrid; vector; render order; vector tiles
do: Use 'vector' renderMode when exact draw order matters; keep 'hybrid' for speed.
dont: Use hybrid while expecting strict feature draw order.

guideline: VectorTileLayer declutter defaults to false. Layers sharing the same truthy value are decluttered together; preload defaults to 0.
keywords: declutter; label collision; overlapping labels; preload; vector tile
do: Turn on declutter for label and symbol layers, using one shared value to declutter layers together.

guideline: VectorTile source defaults: tileSize 512, maxZoom 22, projection EPSG:3857, overlaps true, wrapX true.
keywords: VectorTile source; tileSize; maxZoom; projection; overlaps; wrapX
do: Match tileSize, maxZoom and projection to the tileset you serve.
dont: Leave defaults when the tileset uses a different tile size or projection.

guideline: WebGL points layers take a literal (JSON) style. ol/layer/WebGLPoints is deprecated in favour of ol/layer/WebGLVector. Dispose the layer manually or the WebGL context leaks; disableHitDetection:true speeds up but turns off hit detection.
keywords: webgl; WebGLVector; WebGLPoints deprecated; dispose; context leak; disableHitDetection; hit detection; many points
do: Use ol/layer/WebGLVector for large point sets and call dispose when removing it.
dont: Start new work on the deprecated WebGLPoints layer, or discard a WebGL layer without disposing it.
